Senior Applied AI Engineer - Flood Intelligence (Remote)

About the role
We are building LLM agents that help water utilities respond to floods. You will design
retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that
connect language models to hydraulic simulators.

Must have
- 4+ years of Python
- Hands-on PyTorch or deep learning experience
- Experience with Docker and Kubernetes
- Built RAG pipelines or LLM agents in production

Nice to have
- HEC-RAS or other 2D hydraulic modelling tools
- AWS (SageMaker, Lambda)
- Google Earth Engine or SAR remote sensing
